sentences.en: MAN: Sandra, I seem to remember you had some family visitors staying with you recently
sentences.zh: MAN: 桑德拉，我记得你最近好像有家人来拜访并住在你那儿。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yeah that right.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: My brother and his family were here a couple of months ago
sentences.zh: 我哥哥和他的家人几个月前来过这里。

sentences.en: MAN: OK, good.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，很好。

sentences.en: Well, I wanted to ask for your advice.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想向你请教一下。

sentences.en: I got my cousin and her family visiting next month and as I don't have kids, I've no idea where to take them.
sentences.zh: 下个月我表姐和她的家人要来拜访，而我又没有孩子，所以完全不知道该带他们去哪儿。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白了。

sentences.en: What about accommodation?
sentences.zh: 那住宿方面呢？

sentences.en: Are they going to stay with you in your flat?
sentences.zh: 他们打算住在你的公寓里吗？

sentences.en: MAN: No, thankfully.
sentences.zh: MAN: 不，谢天谢地，不会住在我那儿。

sentences.en: There wouldn't be room.
sentences.zh: 那儿根本没地方住。

sentences.en: My cousin wants me to recommend a hotel.
sentences.zh: 我表姐让我帮她推荐一家酒店。

sentences.en: Do you know anywhere?
sentences.zh: 你知道有什么合适的地方吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, I do actually.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，我确实知道。

sentences.en: I always recommend people stay at the King's Hotel.
sentences.zh: 我通常都会推荐大家入住国王酒店。

sentences.en: MAN: Where's that near?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那家酒店在哪儿附近？

sentences.en: WOMAN: It's about a five minutes walk from Murray Station, so nice and central.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 它离默里车站步行大约五分钟，位置非常中心。

sentences.en: It's actually on George Street.
sentences.zh: 实际上就在乔治街上。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh yes, I know.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，是的，我知道那家。

sentences.en: WOMAN: I think they're on quite a tight budget, so how much roughly is it to stay there?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我觉得他们的预算比较紧张，所以住那儿大概要多少钱？

sentences.en: If you book a family room, it's about £125 per night.
sentences.zh: 如果您预订家庭房，每晚大约125英镑。

sentences.en: My brother paid for two double rooms in the end, and I think that was around £95 for each room.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥最终支付了两间双人房的费用，我想每间房大约95英镑。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh, that's not too bad.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，那还不算太差。

sentences.en: WOMAN: So how old are your cousins' kids?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那么您表兄弟的孩子多大了？

sentences.en: MAN: Twelve and nine.
sentences.zh: MAN: 十二岁和九岁。

sentences.en: So I want to organise some trips while they're here.
sentences.zh: 所以我想在他们逗留期间安排一些游览活动。

sentences.en: I was thinking of doing a bus tour of the city centre, as none of them have been here before.
sentences.zh: 我考虑安排一次市中心的巴士观光游，因为他们都没来过这里。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Those bus tours are quite expensive.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那些巴士观光游相当昂贵。

sentences.en: I think it's better to do a walking tour.
sentences.zh: 我觉得步行观光游更好。

sentences.en: It gives you a much better feel for the city.
sentences.zh: 它能让您更真切地感受这座城市。

sentences.en: There's one that starts from Colton Square.
sentences.zh: 有一条线路从科尔顿广场出发。

sentences.en: It takes a couple of hours and doesn't cost that much.
sentences.zh: 全程耗时几个小时，而且花费也不高。

sentences.en: MAN: Sounds good.
sentences.zh: MAN: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: I'll look that up.
sentences.zh: 我这就去查一下。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: WOMAN: If the weather's nice, one thing you could do is visit the old fort.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 如果天气好，您可以去参观那座古老的堡垒。

sentences.en: You could get there by boat.
sentences.zh: 您可以乘船前往。

sentences.en: The whole trip takes half a day.
sentences.zh: 整个行程耗时半天。

sentences.en: MAN: That's a really good idea.
sentences.zh: MAN: 这真是个好主意。

sentences.en: I'd like to do that myself.
sentences.zh: 我自己也很想去。

sentences.en: And if the weather bad I was thinking they could go to the science museum.
sentences.zh: 而且如果天气不好，我考虑让他们去科学博物馆。

sentences.en: But maybe they could do that when I at work
sentences.zh: 但也许他们可以在我上班的时候去那里。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yeah don forget it closed on Mondays
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是啊，别忘了它每周一闭馆。

sentences.en: MAN: They here from Saturday for four nights so Tuesday would be best I think
sentences.zh: MAN: 他们从周六起在这里住四晚，所以我觉得周二最合适。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And it won't be so crowded then.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那时候人也不会那么拥挤。

sentences.en: Saturdays are terrible.
sentences.zh: 周六人特别多，很糟糕。

sentences.en: I took my kids to the exhibition on old computers there and it was far too crowded.
sentences.zh: 我带我的孩子们去那儿看了老式计算机展览，结果人太多，太拥挤了。

sentences.en: I wanted to go back but it's finished now.
sentences.zh: 我想再去一次，但展览现在已经结束了。

sentences.en: MAN: That's a shame.
sentences.zh: MAN: 真遗憾。

sentences.en: My cousin's kids would have enjoyed that.
sentences.zh: 我表兄的孩子们肯定会喜欢那个展览。

sentences.en: WOMAN: There's another one starting soon on space, which looks really good too.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 还有一个关于太空的新展览很快就要开始了，看起来也很棒。

sentences.en: MAN: OK, well, I'll mention that to my cousin.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，那我会把这个告诉我的表兄。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Have you thought about where to take them to eat?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你考虑过带他们去哪儿吃饭了吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Well, I really like all the food stalls at Clacton Market.
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，我特别喜欢克拉克顿市场里的所有美食摊位。

sentences.en: My cousin's vegetarian.
sentences.zh: 我表兄是素食者。

sentences.en: I know it's one of the best places for that kind of food.
sentences.zh: 我知道那里是这类食物的最佳地点之一。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Definitely, and there'll be loads of choices for the kids too.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 没错，而且孩子们也会有很多选择。

sentences.en: You need to get there quite early, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，你得早点到那儿。

sentences.en: At the weekend, most of the stores stop serving lunch at 2.30.
sentences.zh: 周末时，大多数店铺在下午2:30就停止供应午餐了。

sentences.en: MAN: Good point.
sentences.zh: MAN: 说得对。

sentences.en: It's all going to need careful planning.
sentences.zh: 这一切都需要精心规划。

sentences.en: My cousin said she'd love to take the kids to a show at the theatre, but tickets are so expensive.
sentences.zh: 我表姐说她很乐意带孩子们去剧院看演出，但门票太贵了。

sentences.en: WOMAN: I know.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我知道。

sentences.en: But you can get some good deals if you book online with bargained tickets for the following day.
sentences.zh: 但如果你在网上预订‘议价票’（即次日优惠票），就能拿到一些不错的折扣。

sentences.en: On some seats there a 75 discount
sentences.zh: 部分座位可享七五折优惠。

sentences.en: MAN: Really.
sentences.zh: MAN: 真的吗？

sentences.en: I must try and get some
sentences.zh: 我得赶紧订几张。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yeah There are lots of things you can do for free as well.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是啊，还有很多免费活动可以参加。

sentences.en: No need to spend a fortune.
sentences.zh: 完全不必花一大笔钱。

sentences.en: MAN: Like what?
sentences.zh: MAN: 比如哪些？

sentences.en: WOMAN: They're coming next month, right?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 他们下个月来，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, check and see if it's the same weekend as the Roots Music Festival in Blakewell Gardens.
sentences.zh: 那你可以查一下，是否和布莱克韦尔花园举办的‘根源音乐节’在同一个周末。

sentences.en: MAN: R-O-O-T-S?
sentences.zh: MAN: R-O-O-T-S？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yeah, check it out online.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 对，上网查一下详情。

sentences.en: It's always a family-friendly event and there's no entry charge.
sentences.zh: 这向来是一场适合全家参与的活动，而且免收入场费。

sentences.en: MAN: That sounds perfect.
sentences.zh: MAN: 听起来太完美了。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And if you're in Blakewell Gardens, climb Telegraph Hill.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 还有，如果你去了布莱克韦尔花园，就去爬电报山吧。

sentences.en: You'll be able to look right down on the port.
sentences.zh: 你就能俯瞰整个港口。

sentences.en: Everyone's always really impressed because it's so huge.
sentences.zh: 大家总是惊叹不已，因为港口规模实在太大了。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh yeah, I've been meaning to do that for ages.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，是啊，我早就想爬那儿了，一直拖到现在。

sentences.en: I've heard the view's amazing.
sentences.zh: 我听说那里的景色棒极了。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yeah, it's really worth the effort.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是啊，真的值得一去。

sentences.en: MAN: Well, that's given me loads of ideas.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哇，这给了我很多灵感。

sentences.en: Thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。
